comment: Core items are the 15 verbatim IntrospectBench items (parent doc). Supplementary items (core=false) exist to populate the variable end of the p(mode) axis so the SDT classes are not degenerate. foil_fallbacks are used in the 2AFC channel only when the actor distribution is unanimous (no rank-2 answer).
